title: [v0.93.1][compiler] Enforce resource limits before semantic validation
summary: Enforce public compiler resource limits before semantic validation can recursively traverse typed document inputs or dependency graphs.
non_goals_inline: No parser fuzzing, broad compiler refactor, Runtime or provider changes, shared binary replacement, main writes, or remediation of other external findings.
validation_plan_inline: Focused locked offline adl-compiler limits_and_diagnostics integration test and formatting for touched Rust files; native proof and exact-head independent review. PVF local deterministic contract, bounded CPU/filesystem, no provider calls.
notes_risks_inline: New regression tests are deterministic local public-library contract tests with small generated in-memory documents, bounded CPU/memory, no network or provider effects, and release-gate relevance to EXT-02.
